label: Every GOD_4 apprehending through good-general favouring HAS_INTELLECT_1
paraphrase: OPEN recognition bridge, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every g that is GOD_4, has a good-general favouring determination and itself apprehends some content about some candidate satisfies the unary HAS_INTELLECT_1. The antecedent is existential: a favouring that depends on value for at least one pair of candidates in one scenario. It reads such apprehension as sufficient for intellect, not as required by it. It also carries the intellectual, as against sensory, grade of HAS_INTELLECT_1: dependence of favouring on the value of non-present candidates, with their end content held fixed, is read as grasping goodness under the aspect of goodness; nothing in the apprehension relation itself distinguishes the grades. With About and Apprehends free, it and the cognition criterion together amount to one thesis.
